title: Revision _id tenant|policy|version is ambiguous when tenantId or policyId contains '|'
detail: assertValidTenantId allows '|'. Probe on mongo-store with fake Db: appendRevision('t|a', policy '1', v1) returns true, then appendRevision('t', policy 'a|1', v1, expected 0) returns false (E11000 on _id 't|a|1|1'). A tenant is denied/forced to a false version_conflict by another tenant's row. HTTP blocks '|' in policyId (POLICY_ID regex) but the service/store do not; tenant ids are unconstrained.
fix_direction: Encode _id components (JSON array or length-prefix) or reject '|' in tenantId/policyId at store and service; add a cross-tenant collision regression test.

title: Crash between revision append and change-item insert leaves a revision with no review item
detail: service.append writes the revision then addItemIfAbsent separately. Probe with item insert throwing: revision v1 persisted, queue has 0 items, save threw. Nothing backfills the missing change item later (reconcile only handles conflict items), so the audit queue silently misses that change. No 'current' pointer exists, so history cannot diverge from it (good).
fix_direction: Backfill missing change items from history in reconcile, or write the item first (idempotent by deterministic id) before the revision.

title: mongo-store closeItem updates by _id+status without tenantId in a way the tests do not pin
detail: Mutation M1 (remove tenantId from closeItem filter) SURVIVES all 27 tests. Service getItem guards today, but the store accepts closeItem(tenantB, idOfTenantA, {tenantId B, id}) and would close tenant A's item with B's resolution. Mutations M8 (drop prior-version existence check) and M9 (drop expected+1 check) also survive: no store-level test for version gaps (v1 then v3).
fix_direction: Add store-level tests: cross-tenant closeItem returns false and leaves item open; appendRevision with a gap returns false.

title: Conflict detector misses near-identical question classes and reopens acknowledged conflicts on version bump
detail: Probe: 'course_selection' vs 'course selection', 'course-selection', 'scholarship' vs 'scholarships' and 'career' vs 'career:switch' give no conflict although mode differs. Conflict key embeds versions so any version bump creates a new open item for an already acknowledged conflict.
fix_direction: Normalize _ and - to space; consider prefix overlap; key by policy ids+dimension. file-don't-fix unless roadmap asks.

title: usage.test.ts 'a hanging write does not delay the response' flakes under load (50ms wall-clock bound)
detail: Full apps/api run 3 of 3: tests 955, pass 954, fail 1, failing test src/usage/usage.test.ts:135 'response must not wait for the write'. Isolated: 16/20 pass. Unrelated to the lane (lane touches only apps/api/src/answer-policy). This attributes the unattributed flake from the manifest.
fix_direction: Loosen the bound or use a fake clock; owner of usage tests.
